name: Smart Support
source: Smart Support Panel V1.3.0 based on V1.2.0; start/extend/stop can be authorized by clients when Client Mode allows it
frontend_source: Smart Support Panel V1.2.0; V1.1.2 backend/session contract preserved
storage_migration: none; optional action presentation fields live inside existing smart_support_panel.config
ordering: compact action order editor mutates only actions.buttons order in the editor working copy
personalization: global and per-action text, colors, alignment, layout and sizes with inherited fallbacks
color_picker_guard: native color input events update working copy without rebuilding the drawer until change
client_authorization: start/extend/stop websocket commands accept non-administrators only when Client Mode enables it; config, verify and reset stay administrator-only; the support account cannot start or extend itself
